reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x00403DF0 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/go/00403DF0-GOIsBlood.cpp at sha256 467c22e715a577c44af17afeccdb50562deea3e9f80d2ea20309841e00078b73 (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t GOIsBlood(int32_t param_1, float param_2);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

divergences: Frame pointer read from [E+8] instead of [E+0xc].
candidate_comparison.statement: Divergences are listed above; by contract they keep the record at TRANSCRIBED or lower.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail entry 0x00403DF0 is recovered by all three tools; the address-bound implementation is scripts/GameNatives/go/00403DF0-GOIsBlood.cpp (sha256 467c22e715a577c44af17afeccdb50562deea3e9f80d2ea20309841e00078b73). Single block 0x403DF0-0x403E55: byte g_bc1e2c[g_bc2380*0x564]=Script_EvalArgInt(frame,0); memcpy([E+4],{0,0,0,&g_script_ret_type},0x18); return arg1.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: Retail frame [E+0xc]; BN (int32_t arg1, float arg2 @ 0xc); candidate param_2 at [E+8].The retail frame slot is [E+0xc] (BN already models it as arg2/arg3 with an explicit @ 0xc offset). The candidate declaration puts its second (or third) parameter at [E+8], the registered argc slot, so the same source compiled into the QVM call site would read the wrong stack word.

checks.detail: Retail CFG: Binary Ninja reports 1 block(s)/0 edge(s) at 0x00403DF0; radare2 recovers the identical 1 block(s)/0 edge(s) (score 1.0000); angr CFGFast recovers 4 block(s) with has_unresolved_jumps=False.

checks.detail: One 0x004B8A20 Script_EvalArgInt(frame,0); the candidate passes the argc slot.

checks.detail: Argument 0; profile stride 0x564; global 0x00BC1E2C; zero 0x18-byte record.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: Byte profile store (retail mov al then mov [..],al); result record at [E+4]; frame read from [E+8] wrong.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t(int32_t arg1, float arg2 @ 0xc)" at 0x00403DF0; radare2 recovers "fcn.00403df0 (int32_t arg_24h_2, int32_t arg_24h);". Both tools place the entry at 0x00403DF0 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t GOIsBlood(int32_t param_1, float param_2);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.
